profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Lead Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in various industries, including cybersecurity, healthcare, and SaaS. Skilled in Go, TypeScript, Ruby. Strong software engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused in Computer Science from The University of Texas at Dallas.
